items.purpose: 封面底图：蜂窝晶格靠右，左侧大面积留白给主标题
items.prompt: 16:9 widescreen 1280x720 keynote background, dark minimal technology aesthetic, deep charcoal #08090C background, indigo #6E7BFF accents. CRITICAL: all lines must be razor sharp, perfectly in focus, crisp hard edges. No blur, no fog, no bokeh, no depth of field, no motion blur. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people. Composition sits in the RIGHT HALF of the frame; the LEFT HALF stays clean empty dark space. Subject: a precise hexagonal honeycomb lattice built from thin glowing indigo lines, receding into the upper right corner with perfect sharpness, tiny bright nodes at each intersection, the lattice is clearly visible and luminous against the black, strong but elegant presence.

items.purpose: 张力页配图：直线在右端崩成乱结，隐喻最后 3% 吃掉全部人力
items.prompt: 16:9 widescreen 1280x720 keynote background, dark minimal technology aesthetic, deep charcoal #08090C background, indigo #6E7BFF accents. CRITICAL: all lines razor sharp, perfectly in focus, crisp hard edges. No blur, no fog, no bokeh, no depth of field. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people. Single subject: one dense chaotic tangled knot, a tight ball of many thin glowing indigo lines crossed and fragmented in every direction, like a snarled ball of luminous thread, wires short-circuiting, a rough jagged scribble of sharp light. The knot sits in the RIGHT THIRD of the frame at mid height and is clearly bright. The left two thirds of the frame is completely flat empty black with absolutely nothing in it. One single thin indigo line trails from the knot off to the left edge, ending abruptly in a glowing dot. The background must be one single uniform flat dark tone across the whole frame, no panels, no split, no visible vertical seam, no hard division, no rectangles.
items.alt_text: 直线在末端崩解成混乱线团的隐喻配图

items.purpose: 自愈页：断线被细丝重新接合，与第02页的乱结形成对仗
items.alt_text: 断线自我接合的修复徽记
items.prompt: 16:9 widescreen keynote graphic, deep charcoal #08090C near-black background. The strokes must be BOLD NEON TUBES: very thick, fully saturated, at MAXIMUM BRIGHTNESS, electric indigo #6E7BFF glowing at full intensity, razor sharp crisp hard edges, no blur no fog no bokeh. Absolutely NO thin hairlines, NO faint dim outlines, every line must be a chunky solid glowing bar. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people. SIZE IS CRITICAL: the emblem must be LARGE and dominate the frame - its height is about 70 percent of the frame HEIGHT and its width about 50 percent of the frame WIDTH, leaving only a narrow black margin of about 15 percent on each side. DO NOT draw a tiny icon floating in a big empty frame; the graphic must nearly fill the picture. Subject: an emblem of REPAIR - one chunky thick indigo ring broken by a wide gap at the two oclock position, three bold bright filaments arc across the gap welding the two severed ends together, the welded joint is the brightest point. Strong, simple, iconic, poster-like, maximum contrast against the black.
items.notes: 2026-09-23 v5（最终）：v1 全宽细线(墨量2.4%)→v2 全宽粗条(18.4%但宽高比3.55不紧凑)→v3 紧凑但只有164x165、放大2x会糊→v4 亮度够(5.3:1)但主体仍164px→v5 成功。关键 prompt：BOLD NEON TUBES + MAXIMUM BRIGHTNESS（管亮度）与 SIZE IS CRITICAL 70%H/50%W + DO NOT draw a tiny icon（管尺寸）两条要同时写。结果墨量25.2%、对比3.92:1、主体782x729，面板裁后1230x736→缩小到580x385（不放大）。

items.purpose: 总线页：多股细线汇聚成一股主干
items.prompt: 16:9 widescreen keynote graphic, deep charcoal #08090C near-black background, indigo #6E7BFF. CRITICAL: strokes must be THICK and DENSE, at least 6-8 pixels wide at 1280px frame width, fully saturated indigo, razor sharp crisp hard edges, no blur no fog no bokeh no glow haze. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people. COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: the emblem sits in the CENTRE of the frame and occupies about 45% of the frame WIDTH and 55% of the frame HEIGHT, compact and readable, surrounded by empty black. Subject: an emblem of CONVERGENCE - eight to ten thick indigo lines fan in from the left edge and merge into one single bold vertical trunk on the right, like tributaries joining a river, the trunk is the thickest and brightest element. Strong, simple, iconic, poster-like, high contrast.
items.notes: 2026-09-23 v2：v1 汇聚线铺满全幅但极稀（墨量 2.3%）。改要求『粗笔画+居中』后 11.8%。面板用 bus_bg_panel.png（25.3%）
